entities.summary: National Institute of Technology Andhra Pradesh is a public technical university and the 31st NIT established by the Government of India. It was founded in the academic year 2015–16 in Tadepalligudem, Andhra Pradesh. The institute is recognized by the Government of India and currently offers undergraduate (B.Tech.), postgraduate (M.Tech.) and doctoral (Ph.D.) programs.
